study type: Pilot interventional study with retrospective control group
exposure: Intrapartum transperineal ultrasound (ITU) guided labor management protocol (SOFIE)
cohort: The study included 21 laboring women with normal, singleton cephalic pregnancies at or above 37 weeks gestation for the intervention arm, and a control group of 40 matching women whose birth charts were retrospectively analyzed.
finding: The SOFIE protocol, which minimized vaginal examinations through ITU, significantly reduced the number of vaginal examinations, maternal infectious morbidity, and time in labor compared to the control group.
